QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_17

question.text: The PPM-compliance audit is mandatory for Cat III AIFs at the end of each financial year. Findings (and corrective steps) must be communicated to the Trustee/Board/Designated Partners, the Board of the Manager and SEBI within:

answer.text: 1 month from the end of the financial year
3 months from the end of the financial year
6 months from the end of the financial year
9 months from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 9.5.2 states the findings of the audit, along with corrective steps if any, shall be communicated to the Trustee or Board or Designated Partners of the AIF, Board of the Manager and SEBI within 6 MONTHS from the end of the financial year. **The Trap:** Option A is the quantum for PPM-CHANGE intimation (consolidated within 1 month of FY end) — candidates confuse the two clocks. Options B and D are fabricated. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same 6-month window. XIX-B tests the analogous distributor-side obligations. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Calibrate the PPM audit scope around the Cat III-specific items: class-of-units reconciliation, investment-strategy compliance, fund-flow sampling, and management-fees per class — Chapter 9.5.2 lists these as priority areas.
